# DropdownMenu

An action menu (min 12rem, 12px radius, color-border-strong, 4px padding) with optional labels, separators, sub-menus and destructive items.

`Yansu.DropdownMenu` · Menus · with: DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuSub, DropdownMenuSubTrigger, DropdownMenuSubContent
